Being Evolutionarily Enlightened: What Does it Really Mean? In the Dharma of Evolutionary Enlightenment, the realization of the Ground of Being, which has been the crown jewel of Tradition- al Enlightenment throughout the ages, continues to be the corner- stone of this newly emerging path. Yet the New Enlightenment en- riches this classic realization of the True Self, which is unborn, and prior to creation, by adding a novel dimension to the Dharma that exists entirely within creation. It draws our attention to the need to also wake up to our Authentic Self – a state in which we align ourselves with the creative vibrancy of the evolutionary impulse - which was the missing piece in the Traditional Enlightenment schools. And thus in the teachings of Evolutionary Enlightenment the goal is awakening to both timeless, formless Being beyond the world and evolutionary Becoming within the world. So what exactly does it mean, then, to be evolutionarily en- lightened? We define it as the ability to transition effortlessly between the peace and bliss of Being – the goal of Traditional Enlightenment, and the ecstatic urgency and creative vibrancy of evolutionary Becoming – the goal of the New Enlightenment. When you are capable of moving seamlessly and fluidly between both, that’s when you know that evolutionary enlightenment has awakened in you. This smooth movement between Being and Becoming is a spir- itual skill. It magnifies as you realize more and more deeply what is perhaps the most profound mystery of all: that at the deepest possible level Being and Becoming are not-two. The more you live your life based on this radical nonduality of Being and Becoming, the more you become aware that Being and Becoming are fully and simultaneously present in every single moment of existence. They are two aspects of One Ultimate Reality - two sides of the same coin. The creative impulse is always inherently present in the transcendental depths of the Unborn, where it exists as infinite potential, just as the Ground of Being is always present in every move of this dance of creation as its Divine Source. And so, as a practitioner of Evolutionary Enlightenment, when you sit in meditation, you are consciously aware of the timeless stillness and blissful peace of Being. But the moment you get into action you are instantly attuned to the ecstatic urgency of Becom- ing and its boundless evolutionary creativity – yet always without compromising your rootedness in the Transcendental Source Con- dition. You know that the God-Force is sometimes experienced as transcendent peace beyond the cosmos, and sometimes as ecstatic urgency within it. The ability to move gracefully, naturally and ef- fortlessly between these apparently paradoxical expressions of the God-Force is the essence of living an evolutionarily enlightened life. The profundity of this realization, however, only becomes truly whole, potent and complete if we live it together with others. So let us transition now, to the Sangha Jewel of the Triple Gem and explore how we can live an evolutionarily enlightened life not just individually, but also relationally!
